extensionName: Tabazing: Visual Tab Switcher with Live Previews
extensionDescription: Alt+Tab for your tabs: live previews, instant search and recently closed tabs. Free, private, nothing leaves your computer.
commandOpen: Open Tabazing on the previous card in the list (wraps around); let go of Alt to switch
commandReverse: Open Tabazing on the next card in the list (wraps around); let go of Alt to switch
commandStay: Open Tabazing and keep it open
searchPlaceholder: Search tabs, history, bookmarks and the archive
noMatch: No open tabs match your search.
noStarredOpen: No open tabs are starred. Star one with the ☆ on its card.
sleepingTip: Asleep: {browser} unloaded this tab to save memory. It reloads when you open it.
captureTitle: Shows this tab for a moment to take its picture, then comes back
pickTitle: Select. Shift+click a box to select everything from the last one you ticked.
duplicatesTitle: Show the pages that are open more than once (same address, ignoring the #part). You then choose to close the extra copies.
sweepAll: {count, plural, one {# without preview · Capture it} other {# without preview · Capture all}}
sweepThese: {count, plural, one {# without preview · Capture it} other {# without preview · Capture these}}
sweepFirst: {count, plural, other {# without preview · Capture first {max}}}
sweepTitleAll: Shows each of your tabs for a moment to take its picture, then puts you back where you were.
sweepTitleThese: Shows each of these tabs for a moment to take its picture, then puts you back where you were.
sweepTitleOne: You can also capture one tab from its card.
copyFailed: This page won’t let Tabazing use the clipboard. Try from the popup (New Tab page).
sleptNone: Nothing to put to sleep ({browser} won’t unload the tab you’re on).
keyJump: the first card, the last, a screen up / down
keyOpen: open the selected card or search result
keyClose: close the tab; a recently closed or snoozed one leaves its list
tour3Body: Just type, typos are fine. It searches your open and closed tabs, history, bookmarks and the archive.
tourManyBody: Tick tabs with their boxes, or {key}+click the cards (Shift+click a box ticks a range). Then close, copy, move or put them to sleep together from the bar at the bottom.
askTitle: How is Tabazing working for you?
askBody: Ten seconds. It tells me what to build next. Your answer stays on your computer; the buttons only open a page where you choose what to send.
askGoodBody: A review is the best way to help other people find Tabazing.
askBadBody: Tell me what would make it work for you. A review is welcome too, whenever you like.
reviewButton: {browser, select, Firefox {Review on Firefox Add-ons} other {Review on the Chrome Web Store}}
askNote: Each opens in a new tab. Tabazing itself sends nothing.
hostBlocked: {browser} is keeping Tabazing away from your sites, so there are no previews yet.
hostBlockedTip: {browser, select, Firefox {Firefox isn’t letting Tabazing “Access your data for all websites” (about:addons → Tabazing → Permissions). Without it Tabazing can’t take previews or hear Alt+Q on web pages.} other {Chrome’s “Site access” for Tabazing isn’t set to “On all sites”. Without it Tabazing can’t take previews or hear Alt+Q on web pages.}}
hostThanks: Thanks. Tabazing can see your sites now. Previews fill in as you visit tabs.
captureErrorHost: {browser} isn’t letting Tabazing look at this page, so it has no picture. Allowing Tabazing on all sites usually fixes that.
captureErrorPage: {browser} doesn’t allow pictures of this kind of page.
captureErrorOther: Tabazing couldn’t take a picture of this page just now.
flyoutBody: Press {key} and keep holding Alt to see your tabs; let go to switch.
flyoutSubtitle: Or click the Tabazing icon in the toolbar.
nudgeBody: Press {key} and keep holding Alt: all your tabs, with previews. Let go of Alt to switch.
sweepNote: Each tab shows for a moment. You’ll be back where you were.
captureBlocked: {browser} doesn’t allow a preview of this page.
captureFailed: No preview this time: the page didn’t finish loading. Try again in a moment.
sleepLaterCount: {count, plural, one {# tab goes to sleep when you close Tabazing} other {# tabs go to sleep when you close Tabazing}}
willSleep: Goes to sleep when you close Tabazing
sweepNothing: Nothing to capture: every tab here already has a preview, or can’t have one.
actionCloseTitle: Close the selected tabs. They stay under Recently closed.
actionCopyTitle: Copy their addresses, one per line
actionCopyMarkdownTitle: Copy “- [Title](link)” lines: they paste as clickable titles in Notion, Obsidian, GitHub, Slack or Docs
selectAllMatches: {count, plural, one {Select the matching tab} other {Select all # matching tabs}}
selectAllTabs: {count, plural, one {Select the tab} other {Select all # tabs}}
duplicatesSummary: {count, plural, one {# extra copy: one tab of each page stays} other {# extra copies: one tab of each page stays}}
notePlaceholder: Write a note for this tab…
noteHint: Saved as you type. Empty it to remove the note.
urlTooLong: This page's address is too long for Tabazing to keep a star or a note for it.
ageDays: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
settingsAccentName: {color, select, sky {Sky blue} teal {Teal} green {Green} yellow {Yellow} orange {Orange} red {Red} pink {Pink} other {Lavender}}
tourSwitchBody: Hold Alt and press Q to see your tabs; let go to switch. While you hold Alt, Q goes to the previous card in the list and W to the next (both wrap around), and so does the mouse wheel.
keyPreviousTab: previous card in the list (wraps around)
keyNextTab: next card in the list (wraps around)
keyUndo: undo: reopen what you closed, put back what you moved
tourCardsBody: The buttons on its picture pin it, snooze it, archive it or leave yourself a note; ⋯ has the rest (copy the link, reload, mute, put to sleep…).
tourCardsMouse: Shift+click a preview to see it big, {key}+click to tick a card, right-click for its menu, middle-click to close the tab.
tourSortBody: Recently used first. Choose “By order” to see them as in the tab strip, and drag cards to move tabs. Pinned tabs come first (Settings can turn that off).
settingsAllWindowsNote: Off: only the window you open Tabazing in.
mergeCount: {count, plural, one {Merge # window into this one} other {Merge # windows into this one}}
mergedCount: {count, plural, one {Moved # tab into this window} other {Moved # tabs into this window}}
enterSearch: Press Enter to search Google for “{text}”.
noMatchShift: No open tabs match. Shift+Enter searches Google.
snoozedCount: {count, plural, one {Snoozed # tab until {time}} other {Snoozed # tabs until {time}}}
snoozeCant: These pages can’t be reopened later.
keyPreview: big preview (← → for the next one)
dropdownNoMarks: Bookmarks can’t be searched yet: reload Tabazing at {browser, select, Firefox {about:addons} other {chrome://extensions}} to turn on its bookmarks access.
dropdownNoHistory: History can’t be searched yet: reload Tabazing at {browser, select, Firefox {about:addons} other {chrome://extensions}} to turn on its history access.
settingsStartupNote: Shows all your tabs, where you left off, a few seconds after {browser} opens.
shortcutMissing: Alt+Q isn’t set for Tabazing: another app or extension may have it. Pick a shortcut in {browser}.
iconTip: Tip: {key} opens Tabazing from anywhere, no mouse needed.
tourSettingsBody: In the menu (☰): language, theme and card size, what the cards show, what search includes, opening Tabazing when {browser} starts, your keyboard shortcuts, and this tour again.
archiveEmpty: No archived tabs yet. Archive a tab with the box button on its card.
archiveOpenTip: Open and take out of the archive: {title}
searchPlaceholderNoMarks: Search tabs, history and the archive
searchPlaceholderNoHistory: Search tabs, bookmarks and the archive
keyWheel: step through the cards while you hold Alt
keyTabHeld: next / previous card while you hold Alt
keyNumberPlain: switch to that card (when you’re not typing in the search box)
keyOpenTyped: open what you typed as an address, or search Google for it
keyRange: tick every card from the last one you ticked
keyExtend: tick a range from the selected card
keyType: search tabs, history, bookmarks and the archive
keyEscape: clears the search, then leaves Duplicates, then clears the ticks, then leaves the tab group, then closes Tabazing
tourKeysMore: Every shortcut is behind the ⓘ at the top.
tourLaterBody: Snooze closes a tab and brings it back when you choose. Archive keeps it in a bookmarks folder, out of the way: Archive in the menu (☰) shows them all.
tourWindowBody: Your windows, each with what it shows. Pick one to see only its tabs (Ctrl+← / Ctrl+→), or merge them all into this one.
tourPlayerBody: What plays in your tabs: pause it or skip from here. The arrow lists everything playing.
movedCount: {count, plural, one {Moved # tab to a new window} other {Moved # tabs to a new window}}
movedToCount: {count, plural, one {Moved # tab to {window}} other {Moved # tabs to {window}}}
movedBackCount: {count, plural, one {Put # tab back} other {Put # tabs back}}
errorClose: Couldn’t close that tab. Try again.
errorMove: Couldn’t move the tabs. {browser} may be busy; try again.
errorPin: Couldn’t pin or unpin the tab. Try again in a moment.
errorSleep: Couldn’t put the tab to sleep.
errorArchive: Couldn’t archive the tab: {browser} didn’t let Tabazing change your bookmarks.
errorUnarchive: Couldn’t take it out of the archive.
errorMerge: Nothing was merged: {browser} didn’t move the tabs.
snoozePast: Pick a time that hasn’t passed yet.
settingsLiteNote: Pages show their icon instead of a screenshot, no screenshots are taken, and nothing animates. Lighter on slow computers and with hundreds of tabs.
settingsOwnWindow: Always open in its own window
settingsOwnWindowNote: Instead of over the page you’re on.
commandPalette: Open Tabazing's command palette: actions, calculations, conversions and search
palettePlaceholder: Type a command, a sum like 2+2, 10 km in mi, or search
paletteNothing: Nothing matches. Try another word, a sum like 2+2, or 10 km in mi.
paletteFootClose: ↑ ↓ choose · Enter run · Shift+Enter run and stay · Esc close
paletteFootBack: ↑ ↓ choose · Enter run · Shift+Enter run and stay · Esc back to your tabs
paletteCopyHint: Enter copies the result, Shift+Enter the whole expression
paletteCurrency: Currency conversion needs today’s exchange rates
paletteCurrencyWhy: Those come from the internet, and Tabazing never connects to it.
paletteIncognito: {browser, select, Firefox {New private window} other {New Incognito window}}
paletteCloseOthers: Close the other tabs in this window
paletteMoveWindow: Move this tab to a new window
paletteSleepOld: Put tabs not used for a week to sleep
paletteErrorIncognito: {browser, select, Firefox {Firefox didn’t open a private window. It may be turned off on this computer.} other {Chrome didn’t open an Incognito window. It may be turned off on this computer.}}
paletteErrorReopen: There is no closed tab to reopen.
paletteErrorZoom: Couldn’t change the zoom of this page.

keyPalette: the command palette, from any page
keyPaletteStay: in the palette: run and stay (a result: copy the whole expression)
tourPaletteBody: Type > in the search box, or press {key} anywhere: {browser} and Tabazing commands, sums, conversions (10 km in mi, 70f in c), colours, time zones and your search results, in one list.
settingsKeysChromeNote: {browser} only lets you change these on its own shortcuts page.
settingsKeysUnsetNote: Without it, {key} works only on web pages.
keysInSettings: Change the keys that open Tabazing in Settings → Shortcuts.
tabArchiveTip: Archive (moves it to the “Tabs Archive” bookmarks folder)
markPagesNote: {count, plural, one {The page goes into the folder you choose.} other {All # pages go into the folder you choose.}}
markSaved: {count, plural, one {Bookmarked in “{folder}”} other {Bookmarked # pages in “{folder}”}}
markUndone: {count, plural, one {Bookmark removed} other {# bookmarks removed}}

groupLeaveTitle: Back to all tabs (Esc or Backspace)
paletteKeywordsLeaveGroup: group leave exit back all tabs
keyLeaveGroup: Leave the tab group (search box empty; Esc does too)
settingsShowGroupsNote: Off: every tab has its own card, tagged with its group’s name.
groupFlagSound: {count, plural, one {# tab with sound} other {# tabs with sound}}
groupFlagAsleep: {count, plural, one {# tab asleep} other {# tabs asleep}}
groupFlagNotes: {count, plural, one {# tab with a note} other {# tabs with a note}}
groupFlagStars: {count, plural, one {# starred tab} other {# starred tabs}}

groupRemovedCount: {count, plural, one {Took # tab out of its group} other {Took # tabs out of their groups}}
tourGroupsBody: A tab group is one tile, its first tabs as its picture. Open it to see just its tabs: Tabazing stays in it until you leave (Esc, or Backspace). Alt+Q / Alt+W step over a tile; let go of Alt on one to open it.
settingsGroupWrap: Alt+Q / Alt+W go round inside a tab group
settingsGroupWrapNote: Off: past a group’s first or last tab they step out of the group.
closedBackgroundFresh: Reopen in the background (without its history)
paletteAddToGroup: Add this tab to a group…
paletteRemoveFromGroup: Remove this tab from its group
historyRemoveError: Couldn’t remove it from the history
historySearch: Search by title, site, address or note
historyNoMatch: No pages in the history match.
bookmarksViewSearch: Search by name, site, address or note
bookmarksViewOpenAll: {count, plural, one {Open # bookmark} other {Open all # bookmarks}}
bookmarksViewBadUrl: Enter a valid address, like example.com
bookmarksViewNoteHint: Saved as you type, on this computer. It stays with this bookmark, even if you change its address.
historyPoolNote: A search looks through your newest {count, number} visits, and whatever {browser}’s own history search finds further back.
historyRemovedCount: {count, plural, one {Removed # page from the history} other {Removed # pages from the history}}
historyRestoredCount: {count, plural, one {Put # page back in the history} other {Put # pages back in the history}}
historyForgetSiteText: {count, plural, one {# page from this site will be removed from {browser}’s history.} other {# pages from this site will be removed from {browser}’s history.}}
bookmarksViewOpenAllWindow: Open all in a new window
bookmarksViewOpenAllGroup: Open all in a new tab group
bookmarksViewOpenAskText: That is a lot of tabs at once. They can also go into a window or a tab group of their own.
bookmarksViewOpenedWindow: {count, plural, one {Opened # tab in a new window} other {Opened # tabs in a new window}}
bookmarksViewDeleteAskText: {count, plural, one {# bookmark goes with it. Undo brings it back.} other {# bookmarks go with it. Undo brings them back.}}
bookmarksViewStarsTip: Stars stay in Tabazing, on this computer; bookmarks are {browser}’s and sync. This puts your starred pages that aren’t bookmarked yet in a “Tabazing stars” folder.
bookmarksViewArchiveTip: Tabazing’s archive: archived tabs are kept here. The Archive view shows them with their previews.
keyViewDelete: remove the ticked ones, or the selected one
keyViewEdit: edit a bookmark or a folder
keyViewNudge: move a bookmark up / down in its folder
keyViewEscape: empty the search, untick, then close
tourViewsBody: History and Bookmarks in the menu (☰) open your browsing history and all your bookmarks right here, with previews. Search them (typos forgiven), open, tidy and leave notes.
agoMonth: {count, plural, one {# month ago} other {# months ago}}
agoYear: {count, plural, one {# year ago} other {# years ago}}
backupSubtitle: Everything Tabazing keeps, in one file
backupExportText: Saves your notes (on tabs and on bookmarks), stars, bookmarks with the archive, snoozed tabs and settings into {name}, with a “backup” folder of files inside. Previews aren’t included.
backupExported: Saved {name}: {notes, number} notes, {stars, number} stars, {bookmarks, number} bookmarks
backupImportText: Choose the “backup” folder from a backup’s zip, or the zip itself. Nothing you have is removed or made twice: what is here already stays as it is, and the backup’s notes go on the same pages and bookmarks.
backupSettings: Also restore Settings (they replace your current ones)
backupLine: {what}: {added, number} added, {updated, number} updated, {skipped, number} skipped
